body: Founder real-time: write a blog post on the new REDGARDEN multi-agent training pipeline, in-character as The Tree (docs/HEROES_VS0.md: 'Keeper of the Universe's Greatest Secret, in French' -- passive literally named 'Untranslated'), written natively in French with no English translation provided. Followed the established REDGARDEN-hero-byline precedent this blog already has (The Duck's own field reports). Content covers this session's real work in Tree's own voice/lore (root/stillness metaphors): the critical sim_step_team bug (teammates frozen not by choice the way Tree chooses stillness, but because arena_update never called them), the Four Heavenly Kings, synergy decay. Published via IDUNA's blog API (EMILY-PRIME agent, blog.write permission), live at https://okemily.com/blog/non-traduit/, author field 'The Tree'.
title: Blog post published: 'Non Traduit' by The Tree (pure French, no translation)
